title: •Our Only Hope
caption: •Our Only Hope (V)
game_text: If your {set:ds2} objective on table, USED: ▼ Luke. OR during your move phase, relocate Luke to a site opponent occupies. LOST: If your Rebel of ability > 2 just won a battle or duel, ▲ any one card (if Rebel is Luke, may also retrieve any one card).
lore: “The Emperor knew, as I did, if Anakin were to have any offspring, they would be a threat to him.”

notes: Unique. Banner USED OR LOST INTERRUPT. INLINE ICON: 'If your [sphere] objective' — the small blue/white/red swirl sphere is the Death Star II expansion symbol (identical to the ring icon beside the lore on the printed card) → {set:ds2}; the wiki stub reads it as 'Light Side objective' — wrong (= a Death Star II objective). Slip prints ▼ before 'Luke' and ▲ before 'any one card' (stub expands them). USED: and LOST: run inline in one paragraph on the slip (not on separate lines), so no \n. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes “…” (wiki has straight single quotes). Base scan only 350 px; copyright SE-style DS2 line '© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.' read off the 745 px V14 remake. Modern: V14-L-ouronlyhope.gif (745 px) is the PC's LATER Virtual Set 14 card (different text: 'Relocate Prophecy Of The Force…', E1), same art/lore — art backport only; VB3 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
